## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength, but signals are mixed: HYG/LQD (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND, while XLY/XLP (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.17%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.  
SPY/TLT (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY; VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) ↓ falling, CORRECTION.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress easing: HYG/LQD (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; stocks gaining against bonds: SPY/TLT (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY.  
Fear is easing weekly but remains elevated over the month: VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) ↓ falling, CORRECTION; defensives lead cyclicals on XLY/XLP (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.17%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Dollar strength is increasing: dollar-strength indicator (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.01%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND.  
Curve and duration signals soften: yield-curve indicator (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; duration-preference indicator (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -0.34%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Financials and defensives show broad strength: XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, XLP (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%) ABOVE TREND, and XLU (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND.  
Technology is rebounding but remains weak over the month: XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) RECOVERY; XLK/XLF (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -12.19%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND, points to Value over Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US equities are recovering: SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY; emerging markets are also rebounding: EEM (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -4.75%) RECOVERY.  
India leads: INDA (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND; China remains weak: FXI (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -2.28%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Small caps hold up: IWM (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.89%) ABOVE TREND.  
Speculation remains weak: ARKK (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -16.42%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Copper and precious metals are weak: CPER (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND, GLD (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND, and SLV (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -15.00%) BELOW TREND.  
Copper/gold is attempting a short-term recovery: CPER/GLD (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.61%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy is bouncing, not yet recovered over the month: XLE (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY; Brent remains weak: BNO (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND.  
Natural gas rebounds short-term: UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed strength: XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND; broad sector breadth is 11/11 positive.  
Mixed timeframe signals: SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY and XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) RECOVERY, while TLT (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%) BELOW TREND.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor measured Value/cyclical exposure, with XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength; keep technology exposure selective as XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) remains in RECOVERY.  
Maintain a balanced risk stance: broad breadth is strong, but speculative assets and several core ETFs show weak monthly momentum.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If broad breadth holds and financial momentum persists, favor XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: If the technology rebound fades, reduce exposure to XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) RECOVERY.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If the weekly rebound persists, monitor XLE (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY and UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: Continued weakness in metals would keep CPER (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%) and GLD (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
Reference ratios: HYG/LQD 0.7484 (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; SPY/TLT 9.5033 (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY.  
Relative leadership markers: XLK/XLF 2.9018 (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -12.19%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; CPER/GLD 0.1028 (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.61%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with broad strength; Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive. Financials lead, with XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND and Value outperforming Growth. Monitor the monthly weakness in XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) RECOVERY and the mixed risk signals.
